summary: Element-level mobile overflow scan at 390x844 (iPhone 13) on /admin, /anmalan, /admin/startnummer after admin login. Used getBoundingClientRect() on every element and excluded descendants of any .overflow-x-auto wrapper. No offending elements were found on any of the three pages.

Zero overflowing elements detected on all three pages. Specific testids (input-bib, lookup-bib, input-time, admin-time-submit, register form inputs, register-submit-button) all measured well within 0..390px.
